title: Guzzler Hunt
summary: Betrayed Guzzlers, bloated things the Sins left behind, crawl out at night and drink the livestock dry. Hunt them down.

dialogue.intro: Fat, pale, always thirsty. They come out of the dark anywhere in the Overworld.
offer: Fat, pale, always thirsty. They come out of the dark anywhere in the Overworld.
Four we've seen. Kill them and the cows stop dying.
